newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-GOALKEEPER REVAULT SIGNS FOR PSG.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-GOALKEEPER REVAULT SIGNS FOR PSG.

text.p: Goalkeeper Christophe Revault completed his transfer to Paris St Germain from Le Havre on Friday when he signed a four-year contract with the French soccer runners-up.

The 25-year-old, whose transfer fee came to 17 million francs ($3.2 million), is on the fringes of France's World Cup squad, having been called by coach Aime Jacquet several times last season, usually as third goalkeeper.

Veteran Bernard Lama, who has 35 caps but missed this month's Tournoi de France World Cup warm-up because of suspension after testing positive for cannabis, has been linked with a move to Spanish champions Real Madrid.
PSG, who will play in next season's expanded European Cup along with French champions Monaco, also confirmed an agreement with Italian striker Marco Simone of AC Milan.
The club's press officer said Simone was expected to sign on Monday.

The Parisian club, who fell short of their hopes of a third league title last season after failing to strengthen their squad adequately, confirmed they have also secured France striker Florian Maurice of Lyon, though he has yet to sign.

Midfielder Leonardo, set to play for world champions Brazil in the Copa America final against hosts Bolivia this weekend, has said he wants to stay at PSG, whom he joined last year, despite reported interest from Barcelona.
